name: how_to_elementor
title: How To
description: The How To Widget lets you create step-by-step instructional content with clear titles, descriptions, images, and estimated times. It's perfect for tutorials, guides, or walkthroughs.

options.description: The How To Widget lets you create step-by-step instructional content with clear titles, descriptions, images, and estimated times. It's perfect for tutorials, guides, or walkthroughs.

params.title: Title
params.name: title
params.default_value: How to Change a Car Tire

params.title: Description
params.name: description
params.default_value: A step-by-step guide to changing a flat car tire safely and efficiently. This how-to covers everything from parking your vehicle securely to installing the spare tire and tightening the lug nuts. Ideal for beginners, it includes helpful tips, essential tools, and estimated time to complete the task with confidence.

params.title: Step Indicator Type
params.name: step_indicator_type
params.description: If 'Icon' is selected, you can customize the icon for each step in the Instructions(Items).

params.title: Supplies
params.name: supplies
params.description: Enter supplies separated by commas (e.g., Spare tire, Car manual, etc).

params.title: Self Hosted Video Link
params.name: self_hosted_video_link
params.description: Please add the link to a self-hosted video, e.g., https://example.com/myvideo.mp4.

params.title: YouTube Video Link
params.name: youtube_video_link
params.description: Please add the embed link of YouTube video, e.g., https://www.youtube.com/embed/MLpWrANjFbI.

params.title: End Note
params.name: end_note
params.default_value: This is how you change a car tire

params.title: Distance From Corner
params.name: distance_from_corner
params.selector_value: transform: translateX(-50%) translateX({{SIZE}}{{UNIT}}) translateY(-50%) rotate(-45deg); margin-top: {{SIZE}}{{UNIT}};

params.title: Tools
params.name: tools
params.description: Enter tools separated by commas (e.g., Jack, Lug wrench, etc).

params_items.title: Link
params_items.name: link
params_items.description: Link to post/product page. Auto-populated when using Posts or WooCommerce Products source.
